items.title: Marico profit jumps 31%, flags rising input costs amid West Asia woes
items.description: Marico has reported a 13% increase in consolidated revenue, driven by strong volume growth in India and international markets. The company highlighted challenges from rising input costs due to geopolitical tensions and adverse weather circumstances. Managing director Saugata Gupta expressed awareness of potential inflation effects, especially in rural areas. Marico aims for mid-20% EBITDA growth by FY27 and expects annual revenue to exceed ₹15,000 crore.

items.title: ITC Q2 net profit falls 20% as high taxes keep margins in check
items.description: ITC reported a 20% decline in standalone net profit for the September quarter despite a 45% increase in revenue. The rise in cigarette taxation significantly impacted profitability, forcing ITC to absorb part of the price hikes. Non-cigarette businesses showed strong growth, achieving the highest revenue growth in 14 quarters. Factors such as inflation and geopolitical tensions continue to affect the operating environment.

items.title: BLS E-Services Q2 Results: Net profit rises 12% YoY pc to Rs 20.5 cr
items.description: BLS E-Services reported a 12.4 percent year-on-year increase in profit after tax for Q2 FY27. The total income for the quarter reached Rs 428.1 crore, up 55.1 percent year-on-year. Additionally, the company's operating EBITDA rose to Rs 28.8 crore, marking a 43.8 percent increase from the previous year. The Business Correspondent segment also achieved a Gross Transaction Value of over Rs 41,400 crore.

items.title: SBI Q2 Results: Standalone profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 23,038 crore, NII jumps 15%
items.description: SBI Q2 Results: Net interest income in the reporting period increased 15% YoY to Rs 49,143 crore.

items.title: Bajaj Finserv Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 23% YoY to Rs 2,758 crore, shares rise 2%
items.description: Bajaj Finserv Q2 Results: The firm’s revenue from operations, meanwhile, increased around 17% YoY to Rs 43,416 crore during the second quarter of FY27, from Rs 37,215 crore reported in the year-ago period.

items.title: CleanMax beats Q2 EBITDA estimates, reports strong H1 growth
items.description: CleanMax has surpassed analyst estimates for the third consecutive quarter, driven by portfolio expansion and strong business performance. The company reported a 58% rise in H1 EBITDA and a six-fold increase in profit after tax (PAT), highlighting its robust growth momentum and improving financial performance.

items.title: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank reports sixth consecutive quarterly loss
items.description: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank experienced a loss of Rs 70 crore in the second quarter, marking six consecutive quarters of decline. The lender’s operating profit was Rs 85 crore, but provisions of Rs 166 crore led to the net loss. Its gross non-performing asset ratio improved slightly, standing at 5.96% at the end of September. The bank's gross loan portfolio saw a year-on-year growth of 7.5%, reaching Rs 20,062 crore.

items.title: Nexus Select Trust’s Q2 NOI rises 8% to Rs 504 cr, consumption up 13%
items.description: Nexus Select Trust reported an 8% year-on-year increase in net operating income for the second quarter. The company's retail assets experienced a 13% rise in consumption compared to the previous year. Nexus declared a distribution of Rs 359 crore, maintaining a 100% payout to unitholders for 13 consecutive quarters. The firm is expanding its portfolio with plans to develop a Grade-A mall and hotel in Guwahati.

items.title: Loan growth, fall in provisions help SBI profits in Q2
items.description: State Bank of India reported a 14% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 23,038 crore, driven by 18% loan growth, higher net interest income, lower deposit costs and reduced loan loss provisions.

items.title: MCX Q2 Results: Profit rockets 130% YoY to Rs 455 crore, revenue jumps 114%
items.description: Multi Commodity Exchange of India reported a 130% year-on-year jump in Q2FY26 consolidated net profit to Rs 454.57 crore, while revenue surged 114%. EBITDA rose 151%, margins expanded and shares touched a fresh 52-week high.

items.title: Bata India Q2 Results: Profit rises 30% at Rs 18 crore, revenue rises to Rs 862 crore
items.description: Bata India Ltd achieved a 30.4% increase in net profit for the September quarter of FY27. Revenue from operations also rose by 7.54% to Rs 861.78 crore compared to the previous year. The company noted significant growth in profit after tax, driven by higher average selling prices. Bata India aims to maintain this growth momentum despite rising input costs and wage revisions. Shares of Bata India Ltd increased by 1.

items.title: Happiest Minds Q2 Results: Profit rises 15% to Rs 62 crore; revenue up 12% to Rs 645 crore
items.description: Happiest Minds Technologies has seen a 15.12% rise in consolidated net profit for the September quarter FY27. Revenue from operations also increased by 12.5% compared to the previous year. The company announced an interim dividend of Rs 3.05 per equity share for the 2026-27 fiscal year. An exceptional charge was included in the quarter's results due to a proposed merger with ITC Infotech.

items.title: Emcure Pharma Q2 Results: Profit jumps 29%  to Rs 325 crore
items.description: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd has posted a remarkable consolidated net profit of Rs 325.06 crore for the September quarter, reflecting substantial growth. Revenue surged from Rs 2,269.82 crore to Rs 2,820.47 crore during this period, with international operations increasing by 34 per cent. Additionally, domestic revenue witnessed an 11.1 per cent rise, as company leaders expressed confidence in sustaining this positive trend through the latter half of FY27.

items.title: Nexus Select Trust Q2 net operating income rises 8 pc to Rs 504 cr
items.description: Nexus Select Trust has announced an 8% increase in its net operating income for the second quarter. The company reported a distribution of Rs 359 crore, reflecting growth in distribution per unit. Nexus Select Trust has cumulatively distributed over Rs 4,400 crore to its unitholders since its listing. The company marks its strategic entry into Northeast India with plans for a mall and hotel in Guwahati.

items.title: V-Mart Retail Q2 loss widens to Rs 16 crore
items.description: V-Mart Retail reported a significant net loss of Rs 16.34 crore for the September quarter of FY27, a rise from Rs 8.87 crore reported in the same quarter of FY26. Revenue from operations saw an upward trend, increasing by 18 percent year-on-year to Rs 952.99 crore. However, total expenses surged by 22 percent, totaling Rs 976.37 crore. For the first half of FY27, total income reached Rs 2,047.

items.title: Minda Corp Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 68% to Rs 143 crore on strong revenue growth
items.description: Minda Corporation Ltd has reported a significant 68.2% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit for Q2. Revenue from operations also increased by 42.6% year-on-year, reaching Rs 2,189 crore. The company's Chairman highlighted continued progress in their growth strategy across key vehicle segments. Electric vehicle-related products contributed around 35% of new order wins during this quarter. Minda plans to enhance its product offerings and invest in R&D and manufacturing capabilities.

items.title: NSE Q2 Results: Profit jumps 23% to Rs 2,578 crore, revenue rises 9%
items.description: NSE Q2 Results: The National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) reported a 23% year-on-year (YoY) increase in its consolidated profit after tax (PAT) to Rs 2,578 crore in the second quarter of FY27 (Q2FY27), compared with Rs 2,098 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year (Q2FY26).
